steps.title: AI Engineering at Tanta University
steps.text: I started with the foundations at the Faculty of Engineering, Tanta University. B.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence Engineering, expected 2027.

steps.title: ML intern at Route
steps.text: Worked with supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, preprocessing, feature engineering and model evaluation, and deployed interactive ML systems.

steps.title: Into GenAI and RAG
steps.text: Somewhere along the way I got more interested in the system around the model than the model itself: getting documents in, getting answers out, and making it clear where an answer came from. So far that has produced MedSeek, Egypt Law RAG, and the AG News service.

steps.title: Now: agentic AI
steps.text: Through DEPI's Agentic AI and Generative AI Systems track I'm learning multi-agent designs, memory, tool use, and how to deploy and monitor these systems responsibly.
exploring: Making LLM calls dependable: retries, circuit breakers, fallbacks
A tiered fallback: hosted API, then a small local model, then rules

alongside: Software internship at DreamSoft on the Dream Gym app: database work in HeidiSQL, QR-based features, and monitoring. First hands-on exposure to Agile and MoSCoW prioritization.
Taught programming to children with PictoBlox and Python at Innova STEM Education.
